tokens.name: brand-neon
tokens.usage: The brand accent, identical in both themes. Live status dots, the chart line, glows. As text only on the dark ground (12.9:1 on `surface`); on light grounds it is a fill, never ink (1.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Diffuse form of the accent: hover edges and hairlines at 8–25% alpha, the solid border of hovered glass. Never a fill.

tokens.name: brand-obsidian
tokens.usage: Deep ink: text on `brand-ivory` slides (16.3:1), the logo and marks knocked out of a neon field, and the ground of occasional dark slides.

tokens.name: brand-canvas
tokens.usage: The outermost canvas behind the dark app shell.

tokens.name: brand-ivory
tokens.usage: Warm ivory. The default background for slides and presentations (with `brand-obsidian` text, 16.3:1). In the product: prompt/input text and high-contrast inverse badges on dark (17.9:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and conversation ground. Dark is the default theme.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed ground behind modal scrims.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest surface step; hover highlight on dense rows.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: code blocks, chart plots, field interiors.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Sidebar rail and quiet side panels.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default card fill.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Raised tiles inside cards (the 8px icon tile of a card header), hovered chrome.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Highest ladder rung: floating menus, selected segmented tab.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Toolbar separators (1px bars 16–24px tall) and gauge tracks.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Material tint colour for tonal elevation overlays.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Document background; same as `surface`.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every `surface` / `surface-container-*` step (≥9.5:1 dark, ≥14:1 light).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Muted text: subtitles, metadata, neutral chrome glyphs, on `surface` through `surface-container-highest` (≥8.5:1 dark, ≥7.3:1 light).

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text on `background`.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Inverse fill for high-contrast tooltips and snackbars.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Inactive glyphs and control borders. Text use on dark only (5.9:1 on `surface`); on light it is 4.3:1 — icons and borders there, not body text.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only; below 3:1 in both themes, so never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Accented text and glyphs: the active nav label, links, the accent icon (16.8:1 dark, 6.2:1 light on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: THE brand neon as a fill, theme-invariant: primary CTA, active states. At most two or three uses per view.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Label text on `primary-container` (the primary button). Source value; 4.6:1 dark, 9.2:1 light.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Accent text on `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Operator/person glyphs and secondary accents (10.9:1 dark, 6.2:1 light on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a `secondary` fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Operator message bubble and quiet selected fills.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: tertiary

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on a `tertiary` fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Tertiary badge fill.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: error

tokens.name: on-error

tokens.name: error-container

tokens.name: on-error-container

tokens.usage: Semantic alias — the neon fill.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Glow colour behind accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Selected-chip and hover wash.

tokens.name: edge-hairline
tokens.usage: The default 1px chromatic border of cards and shells. Borders are never grey.

tokens.name: edge-hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: secondary buttons, flyouts.

tokens.name: edge-focus
tokens.usage: Focus border: 1px, paired with the `focus-ring` glow. Never a browser outline.

tokens.name: field-fill
tokens.usage: Input field fill.

tokens.name: field-ink
tokens.usage: Text typed into inputs and the prompt console.

tokens.name: field-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields. Source value; low contrast by design — never put instructions in a placeholder.

tokens.name: badge-tertiary-ink
tokens.usage: Ink for tertiary-tone badges.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy/live status dot. A dot on light grounds is 1.4:1 — always pair it with its status word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Queued/warning status dot; always with its status word.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error/anomaly status dot and text.

tokens.name: layer-1-bg
tokens.usage: Glass layer 1 fill (module shells, sidebar, top bar) with 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: layer-2-bg
tokens.usage: Glass layer 2 fill (flyouts, prompt console, modals) with 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: aurora-0
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient, stop 1 (0%) — the dark start. Slides only.

tokens.name: aurora-1
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient, stop 2 (38%) — deep brand teal; keeps the dark end green, not grey. Ivory text on it 11.9:1. Slides only.

tokens.name: aurora-2
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient, stop 3 (72%) — mid green. No body text here (ivory 3.1:1); obsidian text 5.3:1. Slides only.

tokens.name: aurora-3
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient, stop 4 (100%) — the brand neon glow. Obsidian text only. Slides only.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: The neon as data: the line or bars on dark/obsidian charts; on ivory only a highlight FILL (1.4:1, so always direct-labelled in `brand-obsidian`), never a thin line or dot.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: The working data series on ivory slides: bars, lines, dots. Deep brand teal, separated from `data-1` by lightness, not hue. 4.7:1 on ivory, so thin marks read; ivory text on it 4.7:1. Validated: CVD ΔE 33 against `data-1`, chroma above the grey floor.

tokens.name: data-muted
tokens.usage: Context marks on ivory charts: the "before", the rest, everything that is not the point. De-emphasis, not a categorical slot; always labelled (1.5:1 on ivory).

tokens.name: glass-tile-light
tokens.usage: Glass grid: the tile fill on light grounds (`brand-ivory`). Frosted white, so the glow reads as a tint through it. Slides and marketing only.

tokens.name: glass-tile-dark
tokens.usage: Glass grid: the tile fill on dark grounds (`brand-obsidian`). Barely there, so the tiles read as dark glass. Slides and marketing only.

tokens.name: glass-glow
tokens.usage: Glass grid: the neon circle behind the tiles, blurred. One per surface, off-centre where four tiles meet. Never carries text.

tokens.name: glass-halo-light
tokens.usage: Glass grid: the wide soft halo around `glass-glow` on light grounds, about twice its size.

tokens.name: glass-halo-dark
tokens.usage: Glass grid: the wide soft halo around `glass-glow` on dark grounds (`aurora-2` at 60%), about twice its size.

tokens.usage: Glass grid tiles at a 1080px canvas (about 13% of a tile); scale with the canvas. Tiles touch, no gap.
